rally.speaker: The Blow
rally.text:
Everyone ends up in the kitchen eventually, but it takes {teen.name} two hours to get home from a friend's, and nobody knew where anyone was.

(No rally cards. Paper Day makes them, and a rehearsal makes them work.)

rally_cards.speaker: The Blow
rally_cards.text:
The rally card is on the fridge: if the power goes and phones don't, call; if phones go, come home; if home's not safe, the Baseline Branch library. {teen.name} is through the door in twenty minutes. It works because it's written down.

The rally plan is rehearsed.

ruth.speaker: Ruth Pellow's porch
ruth.text: Ruth's concentrator is silent. Through the window you can see her switching to a bottle by flashlight.

effects: Ruth starts the check-on chain by lantern. The street chain is formed.

chain.speaker: Ruth Pellow
chain.text: "Knew you would." She has a clipboard already. By nine o'clock, every house on the court has been knocked on twice and the Achterbergs' newborn has a warm room at the Quans'. Ruth runs it like a dispatch board.

arlo.speaker: Arlo Dunmore's garage
arlo.text: There's an engine running in Arlo's garage. The door is down. You can smell it from the sidewalk.

options.text: Bang on the door and get him to open it. Generators kill people in shut garages.
effects: You got Arlo's garage door open before the CO got him.

arlo_ok.speaker: Arlo Dunmore
arlo_ok.text: He comes out gray-faced and dizzy. "I didn't know," he keeps saying. He'll come knocking to borrow fuel next week, and you'll both know why you'd say yes.

arlo_bad.speaker: Arlo Dunmore
arlo_bad.text: The ambulance comes at two in the morning, lights and no siren. He lives. He doesn't know you smelled it.

shortfall.speaker: Sunday, October 10
shortfall.text:
The power comes back at ten. The fridge card has a new line on it, in {partner.name}'s handwriting: what would we have done on day three?

The Blow is the Signal Board's first threat. It has passed.
